comparison.objective: Perform an ordered three-stage liquid dilution with a pipette; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Pipette squeezing, aspiration/dispensing, and contamination-safe sequencing versus rigid tool alignment, rotary adjustment, and torque control.
comparison.success_condition: Correct dilution strengths and order with no back-contamination or spill; no mechanical stop criteria.
comparison.reason: Liquid-transfer sequencing and mechanical commissioning are unrelated tested abilities.
